Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
What happens in a 5 player game (A, B, C, D, E) when there is a
Political Flux in play so the first Methuselah who ousts his/her prey
gains 12 pool (for instance), and Meth A calls a KRC that ousts B
(his/her prey) and D?. Which Methuselah gets the 12 pool? Both A and C?.

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Both, yes.

Messages.Author: Serge Salazar
Messages.Body:
Referencing this same situation if MethA called a KRC and ousted B and C
instead how many VPs would MethA get?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <hizV6.8198$BK3.2...@news1.rdc1.ne.home.com>, Serge
Salazar <serge...@home.com> writes

>Referencing this same situation if MethA called a KRC and ousted B and C
>instead how many VPs would MethA get?

Just one for B being ousted. And B would get one for C being ousted,
but no pool (because B wouldn't be in the game to receive the pool).

This is covered in the rulebook.
